meta.name: pr
meta.description: Use when writing a PR body.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交代码前,把改动整理成一段条理清楚的说明
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次提 PR 都懒得写说明,又想让人一眼看懂改了什么。
copy.tagline_en: Turn your code changes into a clear, well-organized pull request description
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often skip writing PR descriptions and want reviewers to grasp your changes fast.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 写 PR 描述时会套用固定模板:Summary 用伪代码、调用树、文件树或 diff 等图示说明改动;Evidence 贴出改动前后的截图或测试输出;Merge Danger 标注单向门还是双向门及影响范围。
howto.when: 当你要撰写 PR body(PR 描述)时触发,它接管并套用这套模板输出。

say.text: 帮我写这个 PR 的 body
say.note: 按模板三段填写 PR 描述

say.text: 用调用树或 diff 说明这次改动的要点
say.note: 放进 Summary 并配简短文字

say.text: 这个改动回滚代价大吗?写进 Merge Danger
say.note: 标注单向门/双向门与影响范围

howto.what_en: Claude writes PR bodies with a fixed template: Summary shows the change as pseudocode, call tree, file tree, or diff; Evidence gives before/after screenshots or output; Merge Danger marks one-way vs two-way door and blast radius.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you write a PR body; it takes over and fills in this template.

say_en.text: Write the body for this PR
Use a call tree or diff for the key change
say_en.note: Goes under Summary with brief text

say_en.text: Is this change easy to roll back? Add it to Merge Danger
say_en.note: Marks one-way/two-way door and blast radius
